entries.dialogueText: "Go ahead and order your men to apprehend me."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "The Crown has officially lost its legitimacy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: I held up the pen and motioned to the document.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please don't make this difficult...."
entries.dialogueText: "Please don't make this difficult. Just sign your name and get this over with."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You can't come out of this looking..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't come out of this looking like a martyr. We'll make you sign the papers, just as we did with the General."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine. Titus, you heard her. Arrest..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. Titus, you heard her. Arrest Angelica Sazon immediately."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't have time for this. Titus,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't have time for this. Titus, shoot her."

entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""May she find redemption in the aft..."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And in the end, these titles and l..."
entries.dialogueText: "And in the end, these titles and land aren't really ours to give away, are they? What did either of us do to deserve them?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why would I? You're still the Prin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why would I? You're still the Prince Consort."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Maybe that's for the best.""
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe that's for the best."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Signing our family's fate away? Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Signing our family's fate away? You're no Sazon at all."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""But I know when I'm outnumbered. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I know when I'm outnumbered. I won't put up a fight."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll remind you that you're vastly..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll remind you that you're vastly outnumbered. Think very carefully about your next steps."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't intervene."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't intervene.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: With a long sigh of regret, she lowered her hand again and scribbled her signature on the document.

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Not everything. We still have each..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not everything. We still have each other."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""I hope you're happy, Your Majesty...."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you're happy, Your Majesty. You've taken everything and everyone from me."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Thank you, Your Majesty. And Manus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty. And Manus, I am so sorry."
